announcements.title: A Quick Note from the Aniraku Team
announcements.banner: Thank you for your continued love and support for Aniraku. I am here to listen, buddies.
body:
Hey everyone! 👋

Aniraku is still very much a passion project I keep running between real life and coffee, and your support is what keeps the lights on.

We're now on **V5.8.10.1**. Proper in-app offline downloads are included — no external downloader required. After a download finishes you may sometimes need to go back and then return to the downloads section (or simply reopen the app) for the file to appear. That’s a known quirk I’m still smoothing out.

Important: please fully remove the old V5.7.9 before installing the latest V5.8.10.1 so everything works cleanly.

I’d love to hear from you. Is there anything else you need or any feature you’d really like to see next? Your feedback genuinely shapes the roadmap. If you have anything in mind at all — bugs, missing anime, ideas, or just thoughts — just mail me. I’m honestly a bit sad that almost nobody has said much about the app so far… I keep checking my inbox hoping someone will reach out. Please don’t be shy.

If you enjoy Aniraku and want to help keep it alive, a small donation would mean the world (and a few extra coffees for late-night fixes).

Missing an anime, facing an error, or just want to say hi? Email me anytime.

Thanks for sticking with Aniraku. Now go enjoy some anime.

— the guy who still hasn’t slept enough
